title: [POWERFUL 🔥] COMMAND YOUR DAY IN TOTAL VICTORY BY DECLARING THESE POWERFUL PRAYER
text: Good morning, sons of God. Welcome to your day of total victory. Please understand that the realm of the spirit controls the physical realm. If you do not program your day in the place of prayer, you become a victim of whatever the atmosphere brings. But today we stand as legislators. We stand as kings and priests to command the morning and cause the dawn to know its place. Job 38:12 asked, "Have you commanded the morning since your days began?" This morning we are not begging the day. We are commanding it. We are establishing the ordinances of heaven over your life, your family, and your destiny. Connect your faith with me right now. Begin by giving thanks. Gratitude is the key that opens the gates. Father, I thank you for the gift of life. I thank you because I slept and I awoke for the Lord sustained me. I am not a product of luck. I am a product of grace. Lord, I acknowledge you as the source of my life. I hand over the steering wheel of this day to the Holy Spirit. I declare that I will not run this day in my own strength. Order my steps, oh Lord, in your word. Now, let us deal with the spiritual atmosphere. I take authority over the womb of this morning. I speak into the elements, the sun, the wind, the earth. I command you to cooperate with my destiny today. The sun shall not smite me by day, nor the moon by night. I decree that the lines are falling onto me in pleasant places. I possess my possession today. I forbid any bad news from locating my address. I forbid any sudden tragedy from interrupting my schedule. I draw a line of the blood of Jesus around my life and my family. I speak to the gates of this city and the gates of my industry. Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and let the King of glory come in through my life. I command the two-leaved gates of favor to open onto me. I will not knock on doors that refuse to open. I carry the key of David. I declare that I am a magnet for favor. Men shall go out of their way way to bless me today. I receive the look of approval from my superiors. I receive the cooperation of my colleagues. Where others are rejected, I shall be accepted because of the oil of favor upon my head. I rebuke the spirit of error and mistakes. I have the mind of Christ. I function with a spirit of excellence. I will be at the right place at the right time, saying the right things to the right people. I reject confusion. I reject memory failure. I speak to my finances. I call forth my daily bread. I command resources to locate me from the north, south, east, and west. The wealth of the Gentiles comes to me. I rebuke the devourer for my sake. No emergency expenses shall swallow my joy today. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper." I condemn every tongue that rises against me in judgment. Any gossip, any slander, any conspiracy spoken in secret against my rising, I nullify it by the blood. It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass. I decree that I am a carrier of the presence of God. When I step into a room, darkness must flee. When I step into a room, solutions appear. I am the light of the world. I will shine today. I will not be hidden. Finally, I bless your going out and your coming in. The Lord preserve you from all evil. You will return home with your testimony. You will return home with your sheaves. You will not be a victim of accident or mishap. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in total victory. It is done. Welcome back to the place of spiritual legislation. We are pressing deeper to secure every aspect of your day. Understand that victory is not a suggestion. It is your heritage, but it must be enforced. There are invisible barriers that try to stand between you and your results. Today we shatter them. Lift your voice and declare with me. I decree that every invisible wall standing on my path today is pulled down by fire. I refuse to operate under closed heavens. I command the heavens over my head to be permanently open. I reject the spirit of stagnation. I am moving forward. I speak to the works of my hands. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall bless the work of your hand." I prophesy over my business, my career, and my assignment. My hands are anointed to prosper. Everything I touch today turns to gold. I reject the spirit of average. I function in excellence and high-level precision. I command the spirit of visibility to rest upon me. I refuse to be hidden in the crowd. Let those who carry my answers see me. Let those who need my solutions find me. I tear off every veil of obscurity covering my destiny. My name shall be mentioned in rooms of influence for good. I decree a separation between me and every [music] time waster. I will not spend this day engaging in fruitless conversations. I receive the spirit of discernment to know who is sent by God and who is sent to distract me. I disconnect from every energy vampire and every toxic association. I speak to the specific mountains facing me today. Whether it is a debt, a health report, or a family crisis, I say to you, mountain, move. Who are you, oh great mountain? Before Zerubbabel, you shall become a plain. I level every obstacle standing in my way. I plead the blood of Jesus against the spirit of anxiety and panic. I retain my peace. My heart is fixed trusting in the Lord. I will not make permanent decisions based on temporary pressure. I receive the wisdom of the ancient. I know what to do. I know where to go. I decree that my harvest shall not be given to another. I will not plant for another to eat. I bind the spirit of the waster. My efforts today shall yield maximum results. I rebuke the spirit of almost there. I cross the finish line in every project I undertake. Father, I seal these words. As I step out, let the elements fight for me. Let the systems of this world come under pressure to favor me. I declare that this is the day that the Lord has made, and I will rejoice in the magnitude of my testimony. It is settled. Stand strong in the spirit, for we are taking territory. There is an anointing for speed that must come upon your day. The Bible says the hand of the Lord came upon Elijah, and he outran the chariot of Ahab. I decree that every delay programmed into your day is broken now. Where others are crawling, you will run. Where others are walking, you will fly. I activate divine acceleration over your projects and your assignment. I speak to the ministry of men. God blesses men through men. I call forth your destiny helpers. I command that the specific individuals holding the keys to your next level must locate you today. They will not have rest until they bless you. I rebuke the spirit of anti-favor. I tear off the garment of rejection. You are irresistible to those who are sent to help you. I decree that you have the hearing ear and the seeing eye. You will not miss your moment of visitation. I rebuke spiritual blindness. When your opportunity passes by, you will recognize it. You will not despise the person carrying your blessing. I grant you the spirit of discernment to know what to do and exactly when to do it. I declare preservation over your life. Psalm 91 is your portion. A thousand shall fall at your side, and 10,000 at your right hand, but it shall not come near you. I exempt you from the arrow that flies by day. I exempt you from the destruction that wastes at noonday. You and your household are marked with the touch not seal of the Holy Ghost. I speak vitality into your physical body. I cause the root of fatigue and weakness. You will not break down under pressure. I command your mind to be sharp and your body to be strong. I speak life to your organs. I speak life to your blood. You will finish this day stronger than you started it. I take authority over the atmosphere of your home. Before you return, I command peace to wait for you at the door. I rebuke household wickedness. I rebuke domestic accidents. I declare that your home is a sanctuary of God's presence. No sorrow is permitted to [singing] enter your dwelling place. I decree that any trap set for you by the enemy is broken. If they have dug a pit for you, they shall fall into it themselves. If they have rolled a stone against you, it shall return upon them. You are walking in victory. You are walking in dominion. The Lord is your shield and your buckler. As you go forth, the earth shall yield its increase to you. The sun shall fight your battles. The wind shall carry your name to the ears of kings. You are blessed in your going out and blessed in your coming in. No devil in hell can reverse this decree. It is established. We continue our spiritual legislation. We are enforcing the will of God over every hour of this day. Understand that the enemy often waits for the moments when you are tired or distracted to strike, but we are raising a standard. We are fortifying your mind and your emotions against every assault of the enemy. I speak to your mental atmosphere. 2 Corinthians 10:5 says, "Casting down arguments and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God." I command every thought of fear, anxiety, and doubt to bow to the name of Jesus. I arrest the spirit of panic. You will not lose your peace today. I declare that you have a sound mind. You are emotionally stable and spiritually alert. I break the power of negative cycles. If there is a pattern in your life where things go wrong at the last minute, I interrupt that cycle now. I rebuke [music] the spirit of near success syndrome. You will not just see the promised land, you will enter it. I command that every project you start today must be completed with joy. The anointing of the finisher is upon you. I invoke the law of restoration. Joel 2:25 says, "I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten." I decree that whatever you lost in the past seasons, whether it is money, time, or relationships, God is making a way for its return today. I command a sevenfold restoration of your joy. I command a restoration of your wasted opportunities. I speak over your relationships and interactions. I insulate you from toxic people. I silence the voice of strife and contention. You will not be drawn into battles that do not profit you. I give you the wisdom to know when to speak and when to be silent. Your words shall be seasoned with salt, bringing grace to those who hear. You are a peacemaker and you shall be called a son of God. I decree that your name is being whispered in the ears of those who matter. The book of remembrance is being opened concerning you. Where you have been forgotten, God is raising a voice for you. I command your file to be moved to the top of the pile. I command your application to receive a yes. The favor of God is breaking protocols for your sake. I plead the blood of Jesus against the spirit of bad news. As the day progresses, your phone shall only ring with messages of joy. I cancel every appointment with sorrow. I cancel every appointment with the police or the hospital. You dwell in the secret place of the Most High. Therefore, no evil shall befall you. I speak into your evening. The end of a thing is better than the beginning thereof. I declare that your strength will not fail. You will not return home frustrated. You will return home with a song. I decree that the sun is going down on your troubles, but it is rising on your testimonies. It is sealed. We're entering the final seal of this morning watch. Do not disconnect your spirit. There is a specific anointing that comes to settle the dust of the battle and establish your victory. We are putting the final signature of the Holy Ghost upon your day. Lift your hands and receive the release of your daily provision. The Bible says, "Give us this day our daily bread." I decree that the earth is under pressure to yield its increase to you today. I command resources to flow to you from the north, south, east, and west. I speak to the hidden riches of secret places. Find your way into the hands of this believer. I rebuke the spirit of lack. I rebuke [music] the spirit of scarcity. Today, you will have more than enough. I stand against the spirit of the devourer. Malachi 3 says, "And I will [music] rebuke [singing] the devourer for your sake." I declare that your money will not be wasted on sickness. Your money will not be wasted on car trouble or police cases. I seal every hole in your pocket with the blood of Jesus. You will eat the fruit of your labor. Strangers shall not consume it. I activate the ministry of the Holy Spirit in your life today. Isaiah 30:31 says, "Your ears shall hear a word behind you saying, 'This is the way, walk in it.'" I decree that you will not be confused. You will not take the wrong turn. You will not sign the wrong paper. I sharpen your spiritual sensitivity. You will know exactly what to do to solve that problem at work. You will know exactly what to say to unlock that opportunity. I place the mark of exemption upon you. Galatians 6:17 says, "From now on, let no one trouble me, for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus." I declare that you are touch not to every demon on the road, every witch in the office, and every agent of darkness. When they see you, they will see the fire of God. I surround you with a wall of fire that cannot be penetrated. I speak the effatha anointing over your life. Be opened. I command every closed door that has mocked your efforts to open of its own accord. I command the door of marriage to open. I command the door of career advancement to open. I command the door of international influence to open. What has been hard for others will be easy for you because of the grace of God. I decree that your joy shall remain full. The enemy shall not steal your song. I insulate your emotions from the arrows of depression and heaviness. You carry an atmosphere of celebration. Even in the face of challenges, you will laugh because you know the victory is already won. Now, receive the final blessing. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Go out and conquer. Go out and dominate. Go out and return with your sheaves. It is done. It is sealed. It is settled. Amen. We press further into the realm of the spirit. There is a dimension of dominion that forbids you from being small. Deuteronomy 28 says, "You shall be the head and not the tail. You shall be above only and not beneath." I challenge every spirit of mediocrity that wants to settle in your life. I command you to rise. I command you to exceed the expectations of your lineage. Where your father stopped, you will start. I speak to the voice of the accuser. Revelation 12:10 calls him the accuser of the brethren. Any voice speaking against your promotion in the ears of your helpers, I silence it by fire. Any legal claim the enemy is holding against your destiny because of your background, I blot it out with the blood of Jesus. You are justified. You are discharged and acquitted. I take authority over the spirit of fear. God has not given you a spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind. I rebuke the fear of the future. I rebuke the fear of failure. I rebuke the fear of man. You will walk into that boardroom with the boldness of a lion. You will make that presentation with confidence. Terror shall not come near you. I speak to your physical health. The Bible says if the spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he will quicken your mortal body. I command your body to function perfectly. I curse the root of migraines. I curse the root of high blood pressure. I curse every growth and every pain. You will not spend your profit on hospital bills. Divine health is your bread. >> [music] >> I decree that you are a solution provider. The world waits for the manifestation of the sons of God. Today, you will solve problems that will bring kings to your rising. I activate your creativity. I activate your intellectual capacity. You will not be confused. You will know what to do. You will have the answer that everyone is looking for. I declare peace over your relationships. I bind the spirit of strife and contention in your marriage and your family. Your home shall be a heaven of rest, not a battlefield. I rebuke every spirit of misunderstanding. I command unity to reign. Your children shall be for signs and wonders. They will not be victims of peer pressure or demonic influence. I invoke the covenant of salt over your life. You are the salt of the earth. I declare that you are preserved. You will not decay. You will not rot. Your relevance will not expire. I command that anywhere you enter today, you bring flavor and value. You are indispensable to your generation. I speak against the spirit of delay. The Bible speaks of the set time of favor. I declare that your set time is now. I accelerate your testimony. What took others 10 years to achieve, the grace of God will hand it to you in this season. I command the years the locust has eaten to be restored in sevenfold measure. Father, I seal this morning watch with the blood of the eternal covenant. Let the heavens over this individual remain permanently open. Let the earth yield its increase. Let men yield their favor. Let the angels yield their protection. Go and succeed. Go and prosper. Go and shine. It is done. Amen. We [clears throat] move now to establish your territorial dominion. You are not a tenant in this world. You are a joint heir with Christ. I command the ground you walk upon to recognize your authority. I speak to the elemental forces operating in your city and your region. I compel them to cooperate with your destiny. The earth shall not fight you. The system shall not fight you. I declare that you are the master of your environment. I pray for the spirit of endurance. The Bible speaks of the destruction that wastes at noonday. The attacks that come when the sun is hottest, when the pressure is highest. I decree that your strength shall not fail in the middle of the battle. You will not faint in the day of adversity. I release supernatural stamina upon your spirit, soul, and body. You will finish your schedule with the same energy you started with. I activate the mystery of the hearing ear. Isaiah 30:21 says, "You shall hear a voice behind you saying, 'This is the way.'" I decree that you will not make costly mistakes today. I forbid you from signing contracts that will trap you. I forbid you from entering relationships that will drain you. I activate your spiritual sensitivity to detect danger before it arrives. You will escape the trap of the fowler. I speak against the spirit of jealousy and envy. There are those who are intimidated by your rising. I declare that their evil eye is blinded. I condemn every tongue gathering in secret to discuss your downfall. Let their counsel be turned into foolishness like the counsel of Ahithophel. You will rise and your enemies will watch you rise and be unable to stop it. I decree that your words carry power today. The Bible says life and death are in the power of the tongue. I anoint your mouth. You will not speak defeat. You will not speak lack. Every word you speak over your business and your family shall manifest instantly. I command that when you speak, heaven backs it up. I stand against the spirit of premature death. Psalm 118:17 says, "I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord." I cancel every appointment with the grave. I rebuke the spirit of accidents. I rebuke sudden organ failure. You will fulfill the number of your days. You will see your children's children. Long life is your heritage. I speak to your weekend and your future. I program the rest of this week to favor you. I command Friday to end with a testimony. I command Saturday to bring rest. I command Sunday to bring renewal. I declare that the path of the just is as a shining light that shines brighter and brighter onto the perfect day. Your tomorrow is secured in Christ. Now receive the seal of the prophet. By the power that raised Jesus from the dead, I declare that it is well with you. It is well with your soul. It is well with your pocket. It is well with your going out and your coming in. The Lord cover you with his feathers. The Lord give you peace that passes all understanding. Go and win. Go and reign. It is finished. Amen. We are entering the realm of the extraordinary. There is a dimension of result that hard work alone cannot produce. It is called the anointing of ease. I prophesy over your life that the era of struggle is over. I rebuke the spirit of hardship that makes you sweat for small results. I release the grace for ease upon your destiny. Where others struggle to enter, you will enter with ease. Where others knock for years, the door will open at your first touch. I speak [music] to the book of remembrance. Malachi 3:16 speaks of a book of remembrance written before him. I command that your name be brought up in the hearts of those who have the power to help you. I declare that sleep shall flee from the eyes of your helpers until they settle your case. You will not be forgotten in the prison of obscurity. Your Joseph season of rising has come. I take authority over the spirit of confusion and indecision. Joel 3:14 speaks of multitudes in the valley of decision. I decree that you will not be stuck at the crossroads of life. I activate the spirit of clarity. You will know the right investment. You will know the right partner. You will know the right strategy. The voice of the stranger you will not follow. I challenge every ancient gate standing against your lineage. Psalm 24 says, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates." Every gate of poverty that stopped your father, I command it to bow before you. Every gate of marital delay that stopped your mother, I command it to shatter. You are the pattern breaker of your family. You are the one who crosses the line. I speak into the womb of time. I command the sun, the moon, and the stars to align in your favor. I decree that the elements of creation will fight your battles. When the enemy rises against you, the earth shall open its mouth to help you. You are a cosmic VIP. The universe is commanded to assist your destiny. I plead the blood of Jesus over your reputation. I silence every whisper of slander. I rebuke the spirit of false accusation. Your good name shall not be tarnished. [music] I command honor to pursue you. Men will respect the grace of God upon your life. I clothe you with a garment of dignity and royalty. I decree a supernatural debt cancellation. I speak to the mountain of financial burden. I command it to melt like wax. I call forth streams of income that you did not dig for. I call forth vineyards that you did not plant. I declare that you are lending to nations and borrowing from none. The yoke of borrowership is broken from your neck. I speak to your spiritual life. I command your fire to burn brighter. [music] I rebuke spiritual lethargy. I rebuke prayerlessness. You will not lose your hunger for God. I impart upon you the grace for intercession and the grace for the word. You will grow from glory to glory. You are a giant in the spirit realm. Finally, I seal your destiny with the mark of the blood. No divination shall work against you. No enchantment shall work against your house. You are established in righteousness. You are established in peace. You are established in prosperity. Go and dominate your world. It is done.
